declarations.name: AsyncShareablePassConfiguration
declarations.comment:
A view that asynchronously creatings a `PKAddShareablePassConfiguration` based
on metadatas and an action.

This view is meant to be used in conjunction with `AddPassToWalletButton` when
adding a shareable pass to Wallet. While the configuration is being generated a
`.loading` result will be provided to the content allow a placeholder view to be
shown.

Example Usage:
    AsyncShareablePassConfiguration(metadata: createPassMetadata(), action: .add) { result in
        switch result {
        case .success(let configuration):
            AddPassToWalletButton(configuration) { result in
                // Handle add to Wallet result
            }
            .addPassToWalletButtonStyle(.black)
        case .failure(let error):
            ErrorView(error)
        case .loading:
            LoadingView()
        }
    }
